Professional Summary 
Finance and Automation professional with experience in combining hands-on analytical and automation skills with real finance fluency – 
bringing efficiency and cutting manual efforts  at global financial firms. Strong expertise in Python, SQL, and Power BI for data analysis, 
process transformation , automation, and leadership-ready storytelling . Proven partner in strengthening controls,  driving process 
improvement, system migration and collaborating with senior internal and external stakeholders in high pressure environments. Adept at 
using AI tools to accelerate analysis, code, and reporting workflows.

• Technical Skills: Power BI, DAX, Power Query(M), Data Modelling, Python (Pandas, NumPy), SQL, Advanced Excel, Power Automate 
• Financial Skills: General Ledger (GL) Accounting, P&L analysis, Month-End & Year-End Close, Bank Reconciliations, Financial Planning 
& Analysis, Forecasting, Budgeting, Variance Analysis, Risk Management, Trade Lifecycle Management, SOX & Audit Compliance 
• Systems: SAP, Oracle, Airtable, Cognos TM1 
• Program & Controls: UAT Design & Execution, ERP System Migration, Controls Framework, Risk Identification & Remediation 
• Soft Skills: Cross-functional Collaboration, Stakeholder Management, Process Improvement & Automation, Strategic Communication
